description: CRIT-005 is false for malformed closed models. validScoreOrgan accepts any string period kind and accepts a 36-character run of hyphens as an outcome UUID; an artifact-only probe supplied both invalid values for all four organs and renderScoreCards rendered four cards instead of throwing a load error.

evidence.snippet: The validator checks only typeof period.kind === string and /^outcome:[0-9a-f-]{36}$/ rather than the closed period enum and UUID shape.

resolution.notes: The renderer now enforces exact per-organ period kinds and canonical UUID source references; focused UI and fixed matrix malformed-model probes pass.
